user.title: Sign in to GitHub
user.description: Enter the Client ID of a GitHub OAuth App with **Device Flow** enabled (see the README). You will then sign in on github.com with a one-time code.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to GitHub again
reauth_confirm.description: GitHub no longer accepts the saved access. Sign in again: installed apps stay installed, only the credential changes.

repositories.title: Private app repositories
repositories.description: Select the private repositories to add to the app store. {invalid}

progress.wait_for_device: Open {url} and enter the code **{code}**. This window continues by itself once you approve access.

error.not_app_repository: Not app repositories (no repository.yaml at the root): {invalid}
error.client_id_required: Enter the Client ID of your GitHub OAuth App.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach GitHub. Try again.

abort.no_supervisor: This integration needs Home Assistant OS or Supervised (a Supervisor).
abort.device_flow_failed: GitHub refused to start the sign-in. Check the Client ID and that Device Flow is enabled on the OAuth App.
abort.cannot_list: Could not list your GitHub repositories.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different GitHub account than the one configured.
abort.reauth_successful: Signed in again. Repositories and registry now use the new access.

add.description: Select private repositories to add to the app store. {invalid}

remove.title: Remove repositories
remove.description: Repositories with installed apps cannot be removed. {in_use}

error.not_app_repository: Not app repositories (no repository.yaml at the root): {invalid}
error.in_use: Uninstall the apps from these repositories first: {in_use}
error.supervisor_error: The Supervisor refused the request. See the logs.

abort.cannot_list: Could not list your GitHub repositories.
abort.nothing_to_add: All your private repositories are already added.

registry_conflict.title: {registry} already has another credential
registry_conflict.description: The Supervisor already holds a {registry} credential for user `{user}`, so GitHub Private Apps did not replace it with `{login}`. Remove that registry in Settings > Apps > Store > Registries if your private images need the GitHub sign-in, then reload GitHub Private Apps.
